description: This Java source file implements the ApplicationInfoRepository interface, providing a repository class that loads application information from a database into an in-memory map upon application startup. It uses Spring annotations for component registration and dependency injection.

classes.name: ApplicationInfoRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ApplicationInfoRepository interface; loads application info data from database into a local map upon initialization.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Method annotated with @PostConstruct that loads application info data from database via DAO into the local in-memory map.

methods.name: getAppInfoMap
methods.description: Returns the in-memory map containing AppInfo objects indexed by their ID.
